review_evidence: Reviewed all 66 primary Lean files (~11,405 lines). The source defines formal EVM and Yul syntax, states and executable semantics, together with supporting size lemmas and semantic/notation examples.

summary: Reviewed EVMYulLean and retained the complete EVM/Yul formal semantics and supporting interfaces.
